requirements.title: Core Module Topics
requirements.description: The module covers Hazard Analysis, Evaluation and Approval of Foreign Supplier, Foreign Supplier Verification, Reevaluation of Foreign Supplier Performance and Food Risk, and Corrective Actions. It also covers compliance definitions, applicability, exemptions, and the Food Safety Plan.
